description: Host-neutral policy fixtures for source segments and rich-text run boundaries.

expectations.must-render: A complete expression in one eligible contiguous run must render.
expectations.may-render: A host may coalesce semantically transparent runs, but preserving them is also conformant.
expectations.must-preserve: A host must not coalesce across a semantic run boundary; source and host decoration stay intact.

runKinds.plain: Plain text in the current container.
runKinds.transparent: A text run split only by a wrapper with no attributes or semantics.
runKinds.strong: Strong emphasis or a bold rich-text mark.
runKinds.emphasis: Emphasis or an italic rich-text mark.
runKinds.mark: Highlight or another visible rich-text decoration.

cases.name: complete expression in one plain run
complete expression contained by one formatted run
expression split across adjacent plain text runs
annotation slot crosses a strong-emphasis boundary
annotation slot crosses a highlight boundary
annotation slot crosses a link boundary
annotation slot crosses an inline-code boundary
